# Omission fusion post-discrimination operating points

Fixed formulas/weights from the prior report; no tuning beyond canonical `select_cal_policies`. Five policies per system/seed are fitted on DEV_CAL at budgets 0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, and unconstrained, then evaluated once on DEV_SEARCH. No operating point is filtered by SEARCH FWR. AP is threshold invariant and repeated with each policy for clarity.
